description_zh: 该接口用于发布实时同步任务
name: DeployDISyncTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. Log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace for the current API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Data Integration synchronization task associated with the destination data source. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: a real-time synchronization task in Data Integration.
DI_SOLUTION: a primary site synchronization task in Data Integration
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：

DI_REALTIME：表示数据集成实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示数据集成主站同步任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If TaskType is set to DI_REALTIME, FileId is the file ID of the real-time synchronization task.
If TaskType is set to DI_SOLUTION, FileId is the task ID of the primary site synchronization task.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType为DI_REALTIME时，则FileId为实时同步任务的文件ID。
当TaskType为DI_SOLUTION时，则FileId为主站同步任务的任务ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

schema.description_en: The return result of the Data Integration synchronization task
schema.description_zh: 数据集成同步任务返回结果

Data.description_en: The result of publishing the synchronization task

Message.description_en:
The cause of the failure to publish the Data Integration synchronization task.

If the Data Integration synchronization task is published, this parameter is left empty
Message.description_zh:
发布数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。

如果发布数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
The status of the result of publishing the Data Integration synchronization task. Valid values:

success: The Data Integration synchronization task is published.
fail: The Data Integration synchronization task fails to be published
Status.description_zh:
发布数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：

success：表示发布数据集成同步任务成功。
fail：表示发布数据集成同步任务失败

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful. 
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：

true：成功。 
false：失败
